A shared Zoom room conflict with the Conservation Commission interrupted the meeting, and the committee agreed to end its use of the shared room.
The committee set a plan to finish in about 15 minutes and hand the host role over so the two meetings could be recorded separately.

why_it_matters: Job-description scoring is the step that feeds how town positions are graded, so these unresolved scores bear on future pay-grade placement and the personnel line in the budget, though no change was voted.
The shared Zoom room problem touches whether each board's meeting is recorded separately, which is what lets residents find and watch a specific meeting.
